## Problem or opportunity

What concrete review failure, ambiguity, or unnecessary friction did you observe?

## Proposed minimal change

Name the `SKILL.md` section and provide the smallest wording or structural change.

## Expected behavior

What should an agent do differently? What must remain unchanged?

## Evaluation case

Give a sanitized prompt and pass criteria. Include evidence or source links when the claim is external.

## Safety and privacy check

Confirm that this issue contains no credentials, personal data, customer data, or private links.
